status: Working campaign direction; audience hypotheses, not measured segments. No publication authorization.
rules: Strategy guides selection and wording; only dated claims and current product evidence establish facts.
Choose a reader task and one call to action. Fresh code changes are optional evidence, not a requirement for an evergreen post.
Rotate content themes and products using recent prepared copy. Preparation history is not publication history.
Respect existing account caps and reserved slots. Do not multiply a quota by the number of projects.
Use owned channels first. Community introductions, personal outreach, paid placement, and publication require separate authorization.
Recheck the exact destination and journey before approval. Missing measures are unavailable, not zero.
